Latest: Each entity row reconciles (payable − receivable = printed net), but WRPC's printed total differs from the sum of its rows by ₹2,751,349 payable and ₹2,454,708,850 receivable. Rows are shown as printed. Every one of the 150 rows also ties to the RPC's block-wise data, so the gap is in the printed total, not in the rows. block-level DSM – only partly reconciles (weeks of 26 Oct). Latest: 0 entities' block sums differ from the weekly account; 1 account rows have no block data.
